buzz-cut.definition: A hairstyle created by using electric clippers to trim the hair very close to the scalp at nearly the same length everywhere.

fade.definition: A haircut in which hair gradually becomes shorter toward the sides and back.

taper.definition: A haircut in which hair gradually shortens near the neckline and sides.

crew-cut.definition: A short, even haircut with the hair closely trimmed, traditionally associated with men.

pompadour.definition: A hair style in which the front hair is swept up from the forehead.

undercut.definition: A haircut with very short sides and longer hair on top.

flat-top.definition: A haircut with the hair on top trimmed into a flat shape.

mullet.definition: A haircut with shorter hair at the front and sides and longer hair at the back.

bob.definition: A haircut in which the hair ends around the jaw or neck.

layers.definition: Sections of hair cut to different lengths to create shape or volume.

clippers.definition: An electric tool with moving blades used to cut hair short.

scissors.definition: A tool with two hinged blades used to cut hair.

comb.definition: A flat tool with a row of teeth, used to arrange or untangle hair.
comb.exampleUsage: The comb was used during the activity.

razor.definition: A tool with a sharp blade used to remove hair from the skin.
razor.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Razor" in an educational description.

trimmer.definition: A small electric grooming tool used to shape hair or beard edges.

shaving-brush.definition: A small grooming brush used to spread shaving lather across the face before a razor is used.

spray-bottle.definition: A bottle with a pump that sends liquid out in small drops.

cape.definition: A protective covering worn around a client during barber services.

strop.definition: A leather strip used to sharpen and smooth a straight razor.

haircut.definition: The style in which hair has been cut.

shave.definition: The act of removing hair from the face or body with a razor.

beard-trim.definition: Beard trimming is a common service offered by barbershop staff to maintain a neat appearance.

line-up.definition: Trimming the edges of a hairline or beard into a defined shape.

hot-towel.definition: A warmed towel used for comfort or preparation during grooming services.

shampoo.definition: A liquid soap used for washing your hair and scalp.

conditioning.definition: Applying a hair-care product to make hair softer or easier to manage.

styling.definition: The act of arranging hair into a particular shape or look.

coloring.definition: Changing or adding color to hair using a coloring product.

highlights.definition: Sections of hair colored lighter than the surrounding hair.

gel.definition: A thick styling product used to hold hair in place.

pomade.definition: Hairdressing consisting of a perfumed oil or ointment.

wax.definition: A hair-removal product or a styling product used to shape hair.

mousse.definition: A light foam used to give hair volume and hold.

hairspray.definition: A cosmetic spray that keeps hair in place by leaving a thin coating on its surface.

aftershave.definition: A lotion or other product applied to the skin after shaving.

tonic.definition: A liquid grooming product applied to hair or the scalp.

oil.definition: An oil-based product applied to condition hair or a beard.

cream.definition: A soft grooming product used for skin care, shaving, or styling.

powder.definition: A fine dry grooming product applied to skin or hair.

barber-chair.definition: A substantial chair fixed to the floor can be raised, lowered, or reclined while supporting a barber’s customer.

footrest.definition: A low seat or a stool to rest the feet of a seated person.
footrest.exampleUsage: The footrest was used during the activity.

headrest.definition: A support for the client's head attached to a barber chair.

counter.definition: A work or service surface for tools, products, or payments.

shelf.definition: A support that consists of a horizontal surface for holding objects.

sink.definition: A bowl with taps and a drain, used for washing your hands or face.

sterilizer.definition: Equipment used to sterilize compatible tools under a specified process.
sterilizer.exampleUsage: The sterilizer was used during the activity.

pole.definition: A striped sign traditionally used to identify a barbershop.

waiting-bench.definition: A seat for customers waiting for a haircut.

magazine-rack.definition: A stand with narrow sections for holding magazines.

barber.definition: A person whose job is to cut hair and groom beards.

client.definition: A person receiving a barber's services.

apprentice.definition: A trainee learning barbering through supervised work.

receptionist.definition: A secretary whose main duty is to answer the telephone and receive visitors.

walk-in.definition: A customer who arrives without an appointment.

appointment.definition: An agreed date and time for a service.

tip.definition: Extra money a client gives to staff for their service.

conversation.definition: The use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.

loyalty.definition: The act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action.

tradition.definition: An inherited pattern of thought or action.
